records.plant_name: Sailfish Council Bluffs data center campus
records.monitor_reason: The developer says on-site gas will supply part of the power, but no gas generating capacity, permit or equipment has been named.
records.researcher_notes: A Data Center Dynamics article on Sailfish Digital Ventures from 2025 says the company plans, in Council Bluffs, Iowa, a ten-building, 1 GW campus powered in part by on-site natural gas generation on a 306-acre site. The article is mainly about a Texas campus. A Council Bluffs paragraph sits in the same story, and the Sailfish chief executive says the company has partnered with a natural gas generation developer. I found no source that gives the gas capacity at Council Bluffs, the gas generation partner, a street address, an air permit, a generating certificate or a start of construction. The article says Sailfish had not yet delivered a data center, so the campus may not be funded. The 1 GW figure is the campus size, not the generating capacity. If it is added later, the captive fields would be captive industry use power and captive industry type data center. I searched for Council Bluffs gas generation for other developers too. The only other new Council Bluffs campus I found, Edged's two-building site, is reported at about 200 MW of load with no gas generation.
